sites.name: Loughmoe Castle
sites.description: Loughmoe Castle (Irish: Caisláin Luach Magh, also spelt Loughmore Castle) is a ruined castle in County Tipperary, Ireland.

sites.name: Roscrea Castle
sites.address: Castle Street, Roscrea, Co. Tipperary, Ireland
sites.description: Roscrea Castle is a 13th-century motte-and-bailey castle in the town of Roscrea, Ireland.

sites.name: Ormonde Castle
sites.address: Castle Park, Carrick-on-Suir, Co. Tipperary, E32 CX59, Ireland
sites.description: Ormond Castle (Irish: Caisleán Urmhumhan) is a castle on the River Suir on the east side of Carrick-on-Suir, County Tipperary, Ireland.

features.description: Still operational, making it one of the few working medieval portcullises in Ireland.
Surviving in good condition as part of the castle's original defensive features.
Largely intact, with its upper levels providing views across the River Suir and surrounding landscape.
